insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident; option for worldwide hospitalisation
sub_limits_waiting_notes: 9 base covers + 19 optional covers; any-age entry with lifetime renewal; Waiting Period modification option to 2 or 3 years.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room, ICU, OT, anaesthesia, blood, oxygen, surgical appliances, drugs, diagnostics, implants. Mental healthcare per MHCA 2017.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home Healthcare option (cashless only); pre/post hospitalisation 60/180 days.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in AYUSH Hospital.

maternity_coverage.notes: Parent & Child Care Cover - Basic / Booster; 2 deliveries or 1 delivery + 1 termination; infertility under Booster (up to 50% of normal delivery SI). Entry restricted to age 45.

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn from Day 91 with completed proposal within 90 days (Basic); from birth under Booster; vaccinations until age 1.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor hospitalisation only; donor pre/post hospitalisation excluded.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs.2,000 / Rs.3,500 / Rs.15,000 limit options. Air Ambulance optional cover.

critical_illness_cover.notes: Optional my:health Critical Illness add-on (UIN HDFHLIA22141V032122).

restoration_benefit.notes: Sum Insured Rebound optional cover restores SI up to Basic SI on subsequent hospitalisation.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: 1% of SI up to Rs.5,000 per Insured Person after each block of 4 claim-free years; Preventive Health Check-Up Booster optional annual cover.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Hospitalization expenses anywhere in the world option (worldwide cover).

notable_exclusions_summary: Comprehensive plan with 9 base + 19 optional covers including Air Ambulance, Recovery Benefit, Infertility, Sum Insured Rebound. Mental healthcare covered. Worldwide hospitalisation option.
available_riders: Parent & Child Care Cover - Basic / Booster
